profileText: A Representative from New York; born in Stanford, Dutchess County, N.Y., October 3, 1760; attended the common schools in Smyrna, N.Y.; studied law; was admitted to the bar and practiced in Duanesburg, and Sherburne, N.Y.; served in the Revolutionary War, 1779 and 1780; member of the New York state assembly, 1798, 1803, and 1804, serving one term as member from Albany County, N.Y., and two terms as member from Chenango County, N.Y.; assistant justice of the court of common pleas of Chenango County, N.Y., July 1799-June 1807;  judge of Chenango County, N.Y., 1808-1814; elected as a Federalist to the Thirteenth Congress (March 4, 1813-March 3, 1815); resumed the practice of law in Sherburne, N.Y.; died on February 8, 1843, in Brooklyn, N.Y.; interment in Greenwood Cemetery, Greenwood Heights, N.Y.

note.content: One of two elected to represent 15th district.
